en: A color postcard showing a busy urban square with pedestrians, trees, and several cars and buses from the mid‑20th century. On the right is a yellow historic theater-like building with a decorated facade and a banner above its entrance. In the center background stands a taller, more modern block with vertical window bays and a rooftop sign in a Baltic-style language. On the left edge there is a marquee with neon letters partly visible. The scene is framed by large trees and cobblestone pavement.
